summary: Monitor v3 was intentionally stopped after its original DROID waiter terminated and a corrected unified DROID calibration succeeded; BWM remained running.
evidence: v3 correctly observed the restarted BWM process as running.
Its DROID job referred to the first waiter PID, which terminated BLOCKED before later corrected runs completed.
The final unified DROID v5 result is WORKING and no longer requires active monitoring.
lessons: A monitor configuration must be replaced when an immutable job retry receives a new PID/result path.
limitations: v3 does not represent the final DROID success artifact.
next_actions: Replace v3 with a v4 monitor focused on the still-active BWM run while recording DROID v5 as completed.
